y-m-21-05.title: Masilungelelanise ukuba zeziphi iimilo ezinokuba ziipolihedroni eziqhelekileyo
y-m-21-05.goal: Usebenzisa imeko yokuba isixa seeengile ezijikeleze incopho kufuneka sibe ngaphantsi kwe-360°, fumana zonke (imilo yobuso, inani lobuso obudibanayo) ezinokwenzeka ngaphandle kokushiya nayiphi, uze wahlule ukuba loo meko yimeko efunekayo okanye yimeko eneleyo.
y-m-21-05.material: Ipolihedroni eqhelekileyo sisolidi ekhukhumeleyo apho bonke ubuso bungamapoligoni aqhelekileyo ahambelanayo kwaye inani elifanayo lobuso lidibana kwincopho nganye. UJiyun ufuna ukufumanisa ukuba angayenza na ipolihedroni eqhelekileyo ngokuhlanganisa ubuso obungu-q obungamapoligoni aqhelekileyo anamacala angu-p kwincopho nganye. Libize isixa se-engile enye engaphakathi yepoligoni nganye eqhelekileyo ye-p-gon edityaniswe kwincopho enye 'isixa seeengile ezijikeleze incopho'. Ukuze incopho ibe lugqabi njengesolidi, esi sixa kufuneka sibe ngaphantsi kwe-360° (ukuba yi-360° iba tyaba, kwaye ukuba ingaphezulu kwe-360° ayinakugotywa). Ubuncinane ubuso obu-3 budibana kwincopho enye. I-engile enye engaphakathi yepoligoni eqhelekileyo ye-p-gon yi-180°×(p−2)÷p.

y-m-21-02.title: Iindlela ezimbini zokufumana isixa seengile ezingaphakathi, kodwa iimpendulo ziyahluka?

UHarin: Wazoba zonke iidayagonali ukusuka kwincopho enye ukuya kwezinye iincopho, wahlula ipentagon yaba nonxantathu aba-3, waza wathi 180°×3=540°. Yipentagon efanayo, kodwa iimpendulo ziyahluka. (Isixa seengile ezintathu ezingaphakathi zonxantathu singu-180°.)

y-m-21-01.title: Ukuba ii-engile zilinganisa ngokufanayo, ingaba imigca emibini iyahambelana?

y-m-21-01.material: Umgca n udibana nemigca emibini l no-m. Kumachaphazelo amabini ahlukeneyo P no-Q kuma-n, umgca n udibana no-l no-m ngokulandelelana, yaye umgama phakathi kwe-P ne-Q ngu-6cm (P ingaphezulu, Q ingaphantsi). Vumela i-∠a (i-engile a) ibe yi-engile e-P ekwicala eliphezulu lasekunene la-n, kwaye i-∠b (i-engile b) ibe yi-engile e-Q kwindawo efanayo, ekwicala eliphezulu lasekunene la-n. Ezi ngile zimbini ziingile ezihambelanayo. UJiho ufuna ukwazi ukuba imigca l no-m iyahambelana na. Ukuhambelana kuthetha ukuba azidibani nokuba uzolulela kude kangakanani. (Akukho mfanekiso, ngoko zoba enye engqondweni okanye ephepheni ngokwenkcazelo engentla.)
